units.evidence: Official department page names Management Science and Technology, links its own doctoral programme, and describes operational research among research activities. Management Science in the administrative title satisfies the 25 October title rule.

decisions.reason: Frozen reported doctorate institution, not a department. Official unit and degree identity reviewed separately; no individual degree claim verified.

limitations: Current official three-school/eight-department inventory read; Department of Management Science and Technology is the sole exact-title qualifying formal unit. Other named academic research topics in nonmatching departments are not converted to units.

branches.conclusion: Official eight-department inventory places Management Science and Technology in the School of Business; its doctoral programme and departmental PhD holder/candidate pages establish an active research PhD pathway. No individual thesis area is duplicated as a programme.

Official current university inventory lists three schools and eight departments, with no engineering school or Industrial Engineering department. Named doctoral specializations inside other non-qualifying host departments were not exhaustively screened; coverage remains false.
